description: Plan a deliberate career break — 3 to 12 months off between chapters — with honest runway math, the re-entry story rehearsed before you leave, health/visa/pension admin by country flagged, and kill criteria for coming back early. Use when someone says 'I want to take 6 months off', 'micro-retirement', 'sabbatical planning', 'quit and travel', or 'can I afford a break'.
